title: Universal, sample-optimal algorithms for recovery of anisotropic functions from i.i.d. samples
summary: A key problem in approximation theory is the recovery of high-dimensional functions from samples. In many cases, the functions of interest exhibit anisotropic smoothness, and, in many practical settings, the nature of this anisotropy may be unknown a priori. Therefore, an important question involves the development of universal algorithms, namely, algorithms that simultaneously achieve optimal or near-optimal rates of convergence across a range of different anisotropic smoothness classes.
